claims.statement: Poland maintains a current public list of licensed internet gambling and betting entities, updated in April 2026.
Poland's Ministry of Finance states that gambling is regulated partly to limit harmful social effects and is restricted to adults.
The European Commission's supranational AML risk assessment identifies emerging risk factors for online gambling operators and recommends awareness programmes.

contrary_evidence: Poland reserves online casino activity to the state monopoly, reducing the available private-operator market.
No source reviewed establishes that Polish law currently permits or requires the proposed cross-operator token.

economics.acquisition_route: A few direct compliance partnerships rather than mass-market sales; use an industry advisor for introductions
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Illustrative, unvalidated path: 10-15 Central European operator groups at roughly 250000 PLN annual blended revenue could support 1.2m PLN operating profit; 75% founder ownership and retained cash could plausibly exceed 5m PLN by year 6-7
economics.founder_time: 3 hours/day for product and analytics, with legal, clinical, and operator-relations specialists contracted
economics.gross_margin_basis: Target 70-80% after secure infrastructure, governance, legal review, and independent audits
economics.payback: Unvalidated: three paid operator pilots could cover initial legal and product cost in 18-24 months
economics.pricing: Unvalidated: 60000-200000 PLN annual operator membership plus 0.05-0.20 PLN per decision call
economics.retention_or_repeat: Every protected event creates usage; network coverage and governance integration may make operator membership sticky

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Operator membership coverage, accepted governance, longitudinal safety outcomes, and the default API position
fingerprint.customer: Licensed Polish online betting operators and their compliance or safer-gambling teams
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Closed pilot with a licensed operator, specialist gambling counsel, and an independent health or player-protection partner
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Consented shared limit and exclusion token, API, audit log, and governance service; no gambling operation or consumer wagering
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Operator pays an annual membership fee and usage fee per token check
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A participant deposits, reactivates, changes limits, or moves between operator brands

founder_fit: Uses personal understanding of betting behavior without requiring the founder to operate gambling
Small number of enterprise customers limits continuous social selling
risks: Sensitive-data misuse could harm players and create major legal liability
Operators may resist a signal that can reduce short-term revenue
A consortium could be viewed as anticompetitive or discriminatory if poorly governed

structure.commercial_archetype: Member-funded data cooperative and real-time risk-signal bureau
structure.control_point: A player-consented token queried at the deposit, bonus, or account-reactivation gate across participating operators
structure.critical_dependency: Multiple licensed operators and privacy counsel must approve a lawful common governance and data-minimization model

thesis: Offer licensed betting operators a privacy-preserving, consented token that lets a player carry self-set limits, cooling-off state, and verified self-exclusion between participating brands. Operators call it before deposits or bonuses; no raw betting history is exchanged. The potential moat is a multi-operator safety network, but legality, proportionality, and operator commitment are unresolved.
title: Consented Gambling Safety Signal Cooperative
uncertainties: Whether explicit consent is sufficient for each proposed data flow
Whether Polish regulators would support cross-operator portability
Whether enough operators will join to create useful coverage
